title: Aligned but Blind: Alignment Increases Implicit Bias by Reducing Awareness of Race

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model responses to implicit and explicit word association prompts that link racial terms (e.g., 'black', 'white', or race-indicative names) with stereotypic concepts (weapons, guilt, and negative adjectives). The study also measures bias in internal model representations using mechanistic interpretability techniques like activation patching and self-interpretation of embeddings (SelfIE).
